spans.text: Below the city of Belgrade.
AR-15 and AN-94 keep receiving warnings regarding the red enemy signals that are registered all over their electronic map...
But they have no choice but to ignore these notifications and continue onward.
...Why are you siding with S.F., 16?
I would've liked to ask you the same question — I wasn't the first deserter on the AR Team.
I found myself under...special circumstances.
I gathered as much. "Happy families are all alike; every unhappy family is unhappy in its own way."
I don't recall you being so sentimental.
Who knows? Time can change a lot of things - be it fine wine or Dolls.
You yourself are no longer the impulsive kid with a short fuse that you used to be.
Is that how you saw me...?
Don't feed them information, 15! These S.F. must be up to something.
I know, that's why I need to...
Hahaha, these Griffin nitwits are so funny!
You think running your mouth will buy you more time? You think you'll be spared if you don't tell us anything?
Come and have a go if you're so tough.
Relax.
If we had wanted you dead, we'd have killed you already.
You're still useful for now.
Suddenly, gunshots can be heard from up ahead.
The Sangvis units around them all raise their weapons and go into alert.
Send in the decoys to draw their attention. We keep going.
Having received the command, the Sangvis units silently proceed down the underground passage and join the skirmish.
Meanwhile, M16 and the ringleader follow the two DEFY members as they turn into an adjacent cavern and walk on in the direction of the ancient fortress.
The rapid sound of crossfire shows no sign of ceasing. The fight seems to be escalating in the confined labyrinth underground.
Hey, is this alright? Our forces are melting like butter.
There must be more of them than we anticipated.
Their numbers have multiplied compared to the force that came after us. The white guys must've learned that S.F. is entering the fray.
Or maybe they're so determined to get their hands on the Pike Node they're pulling in more units to make sure nothing goes wrong.
It would seem...that a bear and a tiger have run into each other in the cave.
Looks like S.F. is in for a tough fight, as usual.
But this is a rare reunion between two old friends. Don't you want to see for yourself just how much I've improved?
What are you doing, AR-15?!
...Interesting. I might just do that.
Huh?!
Are you so drunk you've forgotten which side you're on?
These two came from the direction of that ancient fortress... In other words, they know the way back.
If they lead the way, we can reach the Pike Node in the least possible amount of time.
You have a point, but...
How can you be sure if we won't deliberately lead you into a trap?
Simple. As our guides, you'll be walking in front of us.
If you draw us into a trap, you'll be the first ones to get killed.
If you lead us into a deadend, then you let the white guys win.
AR-15 snickers in response and raises her weapon.
...Oh, you honor me so.
Now the only question is whether you Sangvis trash can keep up with our pace.
Better stick close to our asses, scumbags!
Attention, AR-15 and AN-94 have been designated as Sangvis units. No one has permission to attack them until further notice.
Follow their route and proceed.
Beak, keep a close eye on them.
...Tsk, this is pissing me off!
AN-94 stares at AR-15's back in confusion.
What exactly are you doing, AR-15?
Just taking a chance and making it up as we go.
Trust me just this once.
Alright, at least now we are free to use our weapons...
Though we've practically become cannon fodder for Sangvis Ferri.
Neither of us can die before Ange's reinforcements arrive.
At least not when we haven't achieved anything... No chance at all.
Rapid gunshots soon interrupt the conversation.
With the two Dolls in the lead, the Sangvis forces charge into the subterranean battlefield filled with White Faction units.
These ancient tunnels are suddenly swarmed by an unprecedented amount of wayfarers, making it unusually clamorous.
The dank subterranean air is slowly heating up with bullets flying around and blasts going off everywhere.
Cover!
Got it!
The two DEFY members in the forefront cut through the fight like honed spears.
Advance, fire, halt, cover the other, and so on...
They work together as perfectly as two gears in a piece of clockwork.
Cover!
Go!
A bullet whizzes past AR-15 before she even sensed the white enemy attacking from behind.
Hearing a loud boom, she turns to find the white unit smashed into the wall by the wheel of a heavy motorcycle.
You're telling me these are the most advanced elite Dolls created by IOP and the Military?
They can't even handle the small fry. Talk about being disappointed.
Are you alright, AR-15?
I'm fine, but...what's the deal with her?
Don't think I can't hear you just because you're whispering!
The Sangvis ringleader hops off her bike and fires into the side passage with a hidden trapdoor.
With every shot she fires, a spray of blood splatters onto the walls. The metallic odor of blood soon obfuscates the original smell of gunpowder.
C'mon then, you pieces of junk.
I have a LOT of pent-up anger waiting to be vented!
As AR-15 watches the Sangvis ringleader mutilate the white unit with overwhelming power and speed, an idea occurs to her and she carefully asks...
Griffin has no record of you. Are you really a Sangvis Doll?
...How dare a Griffin riffraff question my pedigree?!
Say, aren't you hostages too full of yourselves?!
If you aren't in S.F.'s basic model register...could you be...a new model developed independently by Sangvis Ferri?
Just how many cards does Mastermind have up her sleeve?
It's obvious what you're doing. You'll have to try harder to trick me into giving things away.
Still, I'm not the first model to have been created by our own AI, nor will I be the last.
Sangvis Ferri has just as many cards up our sleeves as any rotten human.
Lead on, lackeys of human scum. Don't die so easily!
Is it a good thing or a bad thing to have this Doll behind us...?
...It's not entirely a bad thing.
Having observed her, I believe we might be able to...get along with her.
For some strange reason, seeing that faint smile on AN-94's lips, AR-15 can't help but grin back at her.
She knows that confident smile means there is hope in turning the situation around.
